# Woodmore Towne Centre Signs New Tenants to Long-Term Leases


August 20, 2026 CityBiz


Body


[Urban Edge Properties](https://uedge.com/) (NYSE:UE) today announced three new long-term leases at[Woodmore Towne Centre](https://woodmoretownecentre.com/) , a 712,000 square foot grocery-anchored, regional power center in Glenarden, MD. Independent[MahoganyBooks](https://www.mahoganybooks.com/) (2,077 SF), national chiropractic clinic[The Joint](https://www.thejoint.com/) **Chiropractic** (1,162 SF), and regional favorite[Milkshake Factory](https://www.milkshakefactory.com/) (1,661 SF) expand the offerings at the open-air property with popular concepts and a new location for a much beloved locally owned bookstore.


Read the full article[here](https://www.citybiz.co/article/890579/woodmore-towne-centre-signs-new-tenants-to-long-term-leases/) .
